_doc: Explicit gateway-prefix overrides for backend services whose spring.application.name cannot be read from source.
Used ONLY when the service's config has no literal name (placeholder like ${SPRING_APPLICATION_NAME}, missing, or empty).
A literal/env value in source always wins; a disagreeing override is reported as a CONFLICT warning.
Key = service name as indexed (BE/<folder>) or just the folder name. Value = {prefix, evidence}.
prefix: lowercase letters/digits/hyphen; unique across services. evidence: where the value was verified.
Never add a prefix you have not verified. Override file path can be changed with KG_GATEWAY_PREFIX_OVERRIDES; KG_GATEWAY_STRICT=1 turns unresolved/conflict/duplicate findings into errors.
